name: @cloudsforge/notify
description: The platform-wide notification service: event to notification mapping, preferences, templates, dedupe, digests, retries, delivery history, operator broadcasts, and developer webhooks as one pipeline.

scripts._test: --test-concurrency=1 is required, not a preference: the database test files truncate this service's tables between cases, and node:test runs FILES in parallel by default. A TRUNCATE takes an AccessExclusiveLock, so one file's reset deadlocks against another file's inserts (40P01). Cases within a file already run in order.

_runtimeDependencies: Siblings are consumed as link: rather than file:. A file: path PACKS the directory and honours
'files': ['dist'], which installs a package whose exports point at src/index.ts while src/ was
never copied — the import then fails at runtime with a module-not-found that names a path
inside node_modules. link: symlinks the working tree, so the unbuilt TypeScript sources these
nodemailer is a runtime dependency and is imported LAZILY, only once SMTP_HOST is set. An
unconfigured transport is a supported mode (see src/email.ts), so the module must not be
needed to boot a deployment that sends no mail.
